description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard tokens.
